title: Learning Steerable Clarification Policies with Collaborative Self-play
abstract: arXiv:2512.04068v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: To handle underspecified or ambiguous queries, AI assistants need a policy for managing their uncertainty to determine (a) when to guess the user intent and answer directly, (b) when to enumerate and answer multiple possible intents, and (c) when to ask a clarifying question. However, such policies are contextually dependent on factors such as user preferences or modality. For example, enumerating multiple possible user intentions is cumbersome on small screens or in a voice setting. In this work, we propose to train steerable policies for managing this uncertainty using self-play. translated_title: 通过协作自我博弈学习可调控的澄清策略
translated_abstract: 为了处理不明确或模糊的查询，AI助手需要一种管理其不确定性的策略，以确定：(a) 何时猜测用户意图并直接回答，(b) 何时列举并回答多个可能的意图，以及 (c) 何时提出澄清问题。然而，此类策略在上下文上依赖于用户偏好或交互模态等因素。例如，在小屏幕或语音环境中列举多个可能的用户意图会十分繁琐。在这项工作中，我们提出使用自我博弈来训练管理这种不确定性的可调控策略。给定两个智能体——一个模拟用户，另一个作为AI助手——我们生成这样的对话：用户发出可能模糊的查询，助手需要决定如何回应。重要的是，模型将每个澄清问题的数值成本以及每个生成词的成本作为输入，并被要求采取能够……的行动（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出通过模拟用户与AI助手之间的协作自我博弈来训练可调控的不确定性管理策略，使AI助手能够根据澄清问题的成本和生成词的成本等因素，灵活决定何时直接回答、何时枚举多种意图或何时提出澄清问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes training steerable uncertainty-management policies through collaborative self-play between a simulated user and an AI assistant, enabling the assistant to flexibly decide when to answer directly, enumerate multiple intents, or ask clarifying questions based on costs such as clarification questions and generated words.
